1. (Currently Amended) A method for synchronous triggering of events in multiple modules, each module receiving a serial bit stream over a respective communications link, each said communications link comprising a data out and a clock line, each said clock line derived from a single clock source, the method comprising the steps of: transmitting a send packet over said data out line to each module synchronous with said clock source wherein said send packet contains at least one bit position defined as a trigger bit __for synchronous measurement triggering across said multiple modules__; and triggering an event __comprising at least one of waveform digitization and waveform synthesis__ in a respective one of said modules upon receipt of a respective one of said at least one trigger bit.

2. (Currently Amended) A method as recited in claim 1 wherein said triggering an event comprises waveform digitization __for synchronous multi-channel measurement__.

4. (Currently Amended) A method as recited in claim 1 said communications link further comprising a data in line and further comprising receiving a serial bit stream over said data in line comprising a receive packet from each said module, wherein a predefined bit in each said receive packet comprises an indication that a measurement is triggered __and said receive packet includes measurement data synchronized across said multiple modules__.

5. (Previously presented) A method as recited in claim 4 wherein said receive packet from each module further comprises a plurality of bits reflecting synchronous results of said triggered measurement.

11. (Currently Amended) An apparatus for performing synchronous triggering of events in multiple modules comprising a housing comprising a controller and receiving two or more modules, a respective serial communications link between said controller and each of said two or more modules, each said communications link comprising a data out and a clock line, each said clock line derived from a single clock source, means for transmitting a send packet over said data out line to each module synchronous with said clock source wherein said send packet contains at least one bit position defined as a trigger bit __for synchronous measurement triggering across said multiple modules__, and means in each said module for triggering a module specific event __comprising at least one of waveform digitization and waveform synthesis__ upon receipt of respective ones of said trigger bits.

12. (Currently Amended) An apparatus as recited in claim 11 wherein one of said events comprises waveform digitization __for synchronous multi-channel measurement__.

14. (Currently Amended) An apparatus as recited in claim 11 said communications link further comprising a data in line and further comprising means for receiving a serial bit stream over said data in line comprising a receive packet from each said module, wherein a predefined bit in each said receive packet comprises an indication that a measurement is triggered __and said receive packet includes measurement data synchronized across said multiple modules__.

15. (Previously presented) An apparatus as recited in claim 14 wherein said receive packet from each module further comprises a plurality of bits reflecting synchronous results of said triggered measurement.

16. (Currently Amended) An apparatus as recited in claim 11 wherein one of said events comprises waveform synthesis __for synchronous signal generation__.
